cards.title: Mood Word
cards.prompt: Describe today’s mood in one word or one emoji.

cards.title: Color of Today
cards.prompt: If today had a color, which would it be?

cards.title: Energy Level
cards.prompt: Where’s your energy level today (1–5)? Why there?

cards.title: State Selector
cards.prompt: Which feels closest right now: relaxed / focused / slightly tense / open to novelty?

cards.title: Natural Style
cards.prompt: What style feels most natural for you lately? (e.g. polished / casual / easygoing / functional)

cards.title: Minifigure Style Direction
cards.prompt: If this minifigure had one overall style, which direction fits you? (e.g. professional / sporty / sci-fi / adventurous)

cards.title: First Impression
cards.prompt: What first impression do you want this figure to give? (e.g. steady, bright, energetic, neutral, gentle…)

cards.title: Material Metaphor
cards.prompt: Pick one material that reflects you today — which one resonates? (e.g. fabric / metal / wood / cotton-soft / etc.)

cards.title: Self vs Alter
cards.prompt: Should this minifigure feel 'more like you' — or 'unlike you' today?

cards.title: Visibility Preference
cards.prompt: Do you want the figure to stay subtle or stand out more?

cards.title: Mood Object
cards.prompt: Is there a small object that could lift your mood today?

cards.title: Everyday Carry
cards.prompt: If the figure could carry one everyday item, what would you choose?
